name: @viborm/studio
description: VibORM Studio: your schema as a diagram, your rows to browse and edit through your own VibORM client

scripts.build: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && tsdown && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('ui/dist/index.html', 'dist/studio.html')"
scripts.compile: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && bun build --compile --bytecode --format=esm --minify --compile-autoload-package-json --compile-autoload-tsconfig bun/main.ts --outfile viborm-studio
